primitives.name: Action Button
primitives.description: Primary and secondary command surface for patient tasks.
notes: The primitive is generic enough to transfer into a target app button implementation.
implementationHints: Map intent states to the app button variant API.
Preserve focus-visible and disabled states when moving to production UI.

states.name: Primary
notes: Used for the next-best patient action.
implementationHints: Use as the default high-emphasis action.

states.name: Secondary
implementationHints: Render with a visible border in low-contrast themes.

states.name: Draft Lab
notes: Exploratory state kept out of production parity expectations.
implementationHints: Do not ship without a product decision.

primitives.name: Status Pill
primitives.description: Compact status label for appointment and care-plan state.
notes: Used by screen sections that need quick scan state.
implementationHints: Keep text short and expose status through accessible text.

states.name: Ready
notes: Used when a task is ready to start.

primitives.name: Info Card
primitives.description: A compact card for care-plan summaries and medication context.
notes: Cards are content containers, not page sections.
implementationHints: Keep radius at 8px or less unless the target app design system differs.

states.name: Compact
notes: Used for lists and short summaries.
implementationHints: Prefer compact for repeated mobile rows.

states.name: Expanded
notes: Used for a primary content module.
implementationHints: Use when a section owns the current task.
